title: Listening (Parts 1–4)
description: Photographs, Question-Response, Conversations and Talks: 100 questions, each recording played only once.

id.title: Listening (Part 1–4)
id.description: Photographs, Question-Response, Conversations dan Talks: 100 soal, setiap rekaman hanya diputar satu kali.

nodes.title: Part 1: Photographs
nodes.summary: Choose the one statement out of four that best describes a photo (6 questions).

objectives.text: Identify statements that correctly describe people's actions and the position of objects
Tell apart 'is being + past participle' (action in progress) from 'has been + past participle' (finished state)
Reject options that mention things not in the photo or use a similar-sounding word

id.title: Part 1: Photographs
id.summary: Memilih satu dari empat pernyataan yang paling tepat menggambarkan sebuah foto (6 soal).

objectives.describe-actions: Mengenali pernyataan yang benar tentang tindakan orang dan posisi benda
objectives.being-vs-been: Membedakan 'is being + past participle' (tindakan sedang berlangsung) dan 'has been + past participle' (keadaan yang sudah selesai)
objectives.photo-traps: Menolak pilihan yang menyebut hal yang tidak ada di foto atau memakai kata yang bunyinya mirip

nodes.title: Part 2: Question-Response
nodes.summary: Pick the best of three spoken responses to a question or statement (25 questions).

objectives.text: Catch the first word of a WH-question and eliminate responses that answer a different question type
Accept natural indirect answers (e.g. 'Let me check the schedule') to a direct question
Respond correctly to statements, suggestions and requests, not only questions

id.title: Part 2: Question-Response
id.summary: Memilih tanggapan terbaik dari tiga jawaban lisan untuk sebuah pertanyaan atau pernyataan (25 soal).

objectives.wh-first-word: Menangkap kata pertama pertanyaan WH dan mencoret jawaban yang menjawab jenis pertanyaan lain
objectives.indirect-answers: Menerima jawaban tidak langsung yang wajar (mis. 'Let me check the schedule') untuk pertanyaan langsung
objectives.statements-requests: Menanggapi pernyataan, saran dan permintaan dengan tepat, bukan hanya pertanyaan

nodes.title: Paraphrase & Distractor Traps
nodes.summary: The correct option usually paraphrases the audio; wrong options repeat its words or sounds.

objectives.text: Match a spoken phrase to its paraphrase in the answer options (e.g. 'the printer is broken' → 'equipment is not working')
Reject options built on repeated or similar-sounding words (e.g. copy / coffee, contract / contact)
Understand the same information spoken in different English accents (e.g. American, British, Australian)

id.title: Jebakan Parafrase & Pengecoh
id.summary: Jawaban benar biasanya memparafrasekan audio; pilihan yang salah mengulang kata atau bunyinya.

objectives.spot-paraphrase: Mencocokkan frasa lisan dengan parafrasenya di pilihan jawaban (mis. 'the printer is broken' → 'equipment is not working')
objectives.sound-alike: Menolak pilihan yang dibuat dari kata yang diulang atau bunyinya mirip (mis. copy / coffee, contract / contact)
objectives.accents: Memahami informasi yang sama yang diucapkan dengan aksen bahasa Inggris yang berbeda (mis. Amerika, Inggris, Australia)

nodes.title: Part 3: Conversations
nodes.summary: Answer three questions about each conversation between two or three speakers (39 questions).

objectives.text: Preview the three questions before the audio and predict what to listen for
Answer gist questions (who, where, why) and detail questions (what, when, how much) from one listening
Follow who says what in conversations with three speakers

id.title: Part 3: Conversations
id.summary: Menjawab tiga soal tentang setiap percakapan antara dua atau tiga pembicara (39 soal).

objectives.preview-questions: Membaca tiga soal sebelum audio diputar dan memprediksi informasi yang perlu didengar
objectives.gist-and-detail: Menjawab soal gambaran umum (siapa, di mana, mengapa) dan soal detail (apa, kapan, berapa) dari satu kali mendengar
objectives.three-speakers: Mengikuti siapa mengatakan apa dalam percakapan dengan tiga pembicara

nodes.title: Part 4: Talks
nodes.summary: Answer three questions about each short talk by one speaker — announcements, messages, tours, reports (30 questions).

objectives.text: Recognise common talk types (voicemail, announcement, tour, broadcast, meeting excerpt) and what each usually asks
Identify the speaker's purpose and the action the listener is asked to take
Keep track of the three answers in the order they come up in the talk

id.title: Part 4: Talks
id.summary: Menjawab tiga soal tentang setiap talk singkat oleh satu pembicara — pengumuman, pesan, tur, laporan (30 soal).

objectives.talk-types: Mengenali jenis talk yang umum (pesan suara, pengumuman, tur, siaran, cuplikan rapat) dan soal yang biasanya ditanyakan
objectives.speaker-purpose: Mengidentifikasi tujuan pembicara dan tindakan yang diminta dari pendengar
objectives.track-order: Mengikuti tiga jawaban sesuai urutan kemunculannya dalam talk

nodes.title: Graphic & Implied-Meaning Questions
nodes.summary: 'Look at the graphic' and 'What does the speaker mean when she says…' questions in the Listening section.

objectives.text: Combine the audio with a schedule, price list, map or chart to choose the answer
Infer what a speaker means by a quoted phrase from its context
Read ahead to the next set of questions while the directions or other audio play

id.title: Soal Grafik & Makna Tersirat
id.summary: Soal 'Look at the graphic' dan 'What does the speaker mean when she says…' di bagian Listening.

objectives.graphic-link: Menggabungkan audio dengan jadwal, daftar harga, peta atau grafik untuk memilih jawaban
objectives.implied-meaning: Menyimpulkan maksud pembicara dari frasa yang dikutip berdasarkan konteksnya
objectives.pacing-listening: Membaca lebih dulu set soal berikutnya saat petunjuk atau audio lain sedang diputar
